sourceEvidence.title: Geared Turbo Fan Quality Manager (Onsite)
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Conducting investigations, analyzing findings, and developing recommendations for corrective actions to address nonconformities.
* Developing and implementing proactive quality initiative strategies.
* Promoting a quality-focused culture through adherence to the Quality Management System (QMS) and Quality Cardinal Rules.
* Ability to work onsite full time in Columbus, GA
**
Qualifications You Must Have:**
* Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of experience, or a minimum of 7 years of experience with an advanced degree.
* Root Cause and Corrective Action experience.
* Experience with AS9100/AS9110 standards.
* Ability to read and interpret technical engineering drawings.
**
Qualifications We Prefer:**
* Proficiency in Solumina G8 or equivalent Engine Maintenance Systems.
* Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office Suite, and data analysis using Excel.
* Experience driving PPAP core elements, including PFMEA, MSA, Process Flow, and Control Plans.
* Background in Continuous Improvement, Lean, and Six-Sigma methodologies.
* Experience communicating effectively with all levels of leadership, both in written and verbal formats.
